I don’t have live web access, so I can’t open Namebeam’s page myself. If you paste the page URL or the question text here I’ll find the date and where it’s published for you.

If you prefer to check it yourself, here’s how to locate it quickly:
- Open the Namebeam Kansas City health insurance page.
- Look near the question text for labels like “First logged,” “Posted,” “Asked,” or “Date logged.”
- If you don’t see that, check above/below the question for a timestamp or the author line (e.g., “Asked on [date]”).
- If still not visible, view the page source (Ctrl+U) and search (Ctrl+F) for “logged”, “posted”, “asked”, “date”, or ISO date strings (YYYY-MM-DD).
- As a fallback, check the bottom of the page for a “last updated” or “published” date, or use Google Cache / Wayback Machine to see the earliest capture.

Send the URL or a screenshot/snippet and I’ll extract the exact date and the publication location.
prompt_text: According to Namebeam's Kansas City health insurance page, on what date was its question first logged? Give the date and say where it is published.
